tests.name: Closed course is 5.069 km and has six named sectors
Every road frame is finite, normalized and orthogonal
Countdown starts a real run and emits GO
Acceleration raises speed without exceeding the base maximum
Right and left steering move the car in the correct directions
Brake stops the car; it never reverses
Nitro is consumed and increases achievable speed
Sustained boost never exceeds the vehicle ceiling in either weather
Releasing boost slows smoothly toward the normal speed ceiling
Empty nitro has a recharge lock rather than flickering boost
Drifting needs speed plus steering and regenerates nitro
Horn moves traffic toward the shoulder and obeys cooldown
Contacts deduct points once during the recovery cooldown
Potholes cost 80 points
Chai pickups award points and refill nitro exactly once
Rickshaw pickup rewards have the promised 25% bonus
Close clean overtakes score, without rewarding collisions
Clean checkpoint adds 23 seconds and 500 points
Pause freezes race time, movement and countdown
Timeout produces an incomplete result, not a false finish
Crossing the finish produces completion, rank and bonus
Sunday drive loops indefinitely and resets lap pickups
Monsoon has more traffic and a lower-grip speed ceiling
Seeded restart reproduces traffic placement
Missing and corrupt saved data are handled safely
Storage save/load round-trips records and settings
Full sunset race completes using only normal driving inputs
Full wet-road race is completable with the rally car
